name: lint and test

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        ruby-version: ["3.3", "3.4", "4.0"]
    name: Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Run tests
        run: make test
        env:
          COVERAGE: true
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: "4.0"
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Run linting
        run: make lint
      - name: Generate config schema
        run: bundle exec rake config:schema
      - name: Ensure config schema is committed
        run: git diff --exit-code schema/html2rss-config.schema.json
      - name: Validate fixture configs
        run: |
          bundle exec exe/html2rss validate spec/fixtures/single.test.yml
          bundle exec exe/html2rss validate spec/fixtures/feeds.test.yml notitle
          ! bundle exec exe/html2rss validate spec/fixtures/invalid_selectors.test.yml
  yard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: "4.0"
          bundler-cache: true
      - run: gem install redcarpet
      - name: Run YARD lint
        run: make lint-yard
      - name: Generate documentation
        run: make docs
      - name: Upload documentation
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: documentation
          path: docs/

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
